# Confidence intervals {#sec-confidence-intervals}

A hypothesis test answers a yes-or-no question about the population. A confidence interval answers a different one: given the data, what range of values for the population quantity is plausible? This chapter builds confidence intervals with the same simulation tools used for hypothesis tests.
